units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 2) ensure the implementation of legal acts of the City of Moscow concerning transferred powers, including legal acts of authorised executive bodies of the City of Moscow exercising state supervision over local self-government bodies’ exercise of transferred powers;
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “2) ensure the implementation of legal acts of the City of…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 3) submit (ensure the submission of), in the prescribed procedure, to authorised executive bodies of the City of Moscow calculations of the financial costs required to exercise transferred powers, reports on their execution, including the use of financial resources, and other documents and information related to the exercise of transferred powers;
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “3) submit (ensure the submission of), in the prescribed…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 4) ensure the designated use and proper maintenance of material resources and the designated use of financial resources provided to local self-government bodies for the exercise of transferred powers;
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “4) ensure the designated use and proper maintenance of material…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 5) ensure the return to the budget of the City of Moscow of interbudgetary transfers received as subventions and not used in the current financial year;
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “5) ensure the return to the budget of the City of Moscow of…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 6) be entitled to request and receive from state authorities of the City of Moscow information concerning the performance of transferred powers, including explanations and recommendations on their exercise;
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “6) be entitled to request and receive from state authorities of…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 7) ensure conditions for state supervisory bodies to supervise the administration’s execution of transferred powers as regards the designated expenditure of financial resources, and to conduct legal examination and analysis of the administration’s legal acts adopted on matters concerning transferred powers, in the forms provided for by legal acts of the City of Moscow;
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “7) ensure conditions for state supervisory bodies to supervise…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 8) within their powers, issue administration resolutions on matters concerning the exercise of transferred powers;
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “8) within their powers, issue administration resolutions on…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 9) exercise other powers established by federal laws and laws of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “9) exercise other powers established by federal laws and laws…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 3. Remuneration of the Head of Administration
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “3. Remuneration of the Head of Administration”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 1. The Head of Administration is paid remuneration comprising:
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “1. The Head of Administration is paid remuneration comprising:”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: an official salary corresponding to the municipal service position held (hereinafter, official salary), amounting to ___________ roubles per month <1>;
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “an official salary corresponding to the municipal service…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: a monthly official salary supplement for class rank amounting to _________ roubles per month;
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “a monthly official salary supplement for class rank amounting…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: and the following additional payments:
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “and the following additional payments:”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: a monthly supplement for length of service amounting to _________ roubles per month;
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “a monthly supplement for length of service amounting to…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: a monthly supplement for special municipal service conditions amounting to _________ roubles per month;
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “a monthly supplement for special municipal service conditions…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: bonuses for performing especially important and complex assignments;
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “bonuses for performing especially important and complex…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: a lump-sum payment for regular annual paid leave;
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “a lump-sum payment for regular annual paid leave;”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: other monthly and additional payments in accordance with federal legislation, laws of the City of Moscow and the Charter of the municipal formation.
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “other monthly and additional payments in accordance with…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: <1> In municipal formations receiving grants from the budget of the City of Moscow to equalise budgetary capacity, the official salary of the head of administration is set at a level not exceeding the official salary of the head of a district board.
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “<1> In municipal formations receiving grants from the budget of…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 2. The representative body independently establishes the amount and terms of the Head of Administration’s pay in accordance with federal laws and laws of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “2. The representative body independently establishes the amount…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 3. The Head of Administration’s remuneration is indexed or increased by the corresponding amounts and at the times established for state civil servants of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “3. The Head of Administration’s remuneration is indexed or…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 4. Working (service) time and rest time
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “4. Working (service) time and rest time”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 1. The Head of Administration’s working (service) time is regulated in accordance with labour legislation and federal laws and laws of the City of Moscow on municipal service.
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “1. The Head of Administration’s working (service) time is…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 2. The Head of Administration is granted annual basic paid leave of 30 calendar days, with retention of the municipal service position held and remuneration.
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “2. The Head of Administration is granted annual basic paid…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 3. The Head of Administration is granted annual additional paid leave for length of service (no more than 10 calendar days) and in the cases provided for by federal laws and laws of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “3. The Head of Administration is granted annual additional paid…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 4. The durations of annual basic paid leave and annual additional paid leave are added together to form annual paid leave, which may be granted in parts at the Head of Administration’s request. One part of the annual paid leave granted must be no shorter than 14 calendar days.
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “4. The durations of annual basic paid leave and annual…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 5. On the Head of Administration’s written application, the Employer’s Representative may decide to grant unpaid leave in the cases provided for by federal laws.
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “5. On the Head of Administration’s written application, the…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 5. Term of this Contract
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “5. Term of this Contract”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 1. The Contract is concluded for __________ <2>.
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “1. The Contract is concluded for __________ <2>.”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: <2> Under Part 8 of Article 20 of Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 “On Municipal Service in the City of Moscow”, the contract is concluded for the term of office of the representative body that decided to appoint the person as head of administration (until the day the newly elected representative body begins its work), but for no less than two years.
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “<2> Under Part 8 of Article 20 of Law of the City of Moscow No.…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 2. The Head of Administration’s powers terminate when this Contract expires or early in accordance with federal laws, laws of the City of Moscow and the Charter of the municipal formation.
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “2. The Head of Administration’s powers terminate when this…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 3. On termination of municipal service, the Head of Administration must return to the administration all documents containing official information and transfer official affairs to their successor in the prescribed procedure.
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “3. On termination of municipal service, the Head of…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 6. Liability of the Parties
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “6. Liability of the Parties”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 1. The Parties are liable under legislation for failure to perform and/or improper performance of the terms of this Contract.
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “1. The Parties are liable under legislation for failure to…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 2. The Head of Administration is liable for failure to perform their duties, including as regards individual state powers transferred to local self-government bodies, in the procedure and on the terms established by federal laws, laws of the City of Moscow and the Charter of the municipal formation.
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “2. The Head of Administration is liable for failure to perform…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 7. Resolution of disputes
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “7. Resolution of disputes”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: Disputes and disagreements under this Contract are resolved by agreement between the Parties or, if no agreement is reached, in the procedure provided for by federal legislation.
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “Disputes and disagreements under this Contract are resolved by…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 8. Final provisions
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “8. Final provisions”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 1. This Contract enters into force on the date it is signed by both Parties and terminates after the Head of Administration’s powers end.
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “1. This Contract enters into force on the date it is signed by…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 2. On matters not regulated by this Contract, the Parties are guided by labour legislation and municipal service legislation.
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “2. On matters not regulated by this Contract, the Parties are…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 3. Either Party may raise with the other the issue of amending (clarifying) or supplementing this Contract; such changes are formalised as written supplementary agreements forming an integral part of this Contract.
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “3. Either Party may raise with the other the issue of amending…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 4. The terms of this Contract may be changed only if labour legislation, municipal service legislation or the Charter of the municipal formation changes.
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “4. The terms of this Contract may be changed only if labour…”

units.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 5. This Contract is drawn up in two counterparts of equal legal force. One is kept by the Employer’s Representative in the Head of Administration’s personal file, and the other by the Head of Administration.
units.label: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “5. This Contract is drawn up in two counterparts of equal legal…”

units.text: 1. General provisions
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “1. General provisions”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 1. These Regulations determine the procedure for assessing municipal servants of local self-government bodies of an intra-city municipal formation in the City of Moscow (hereinafter, municipal servants).
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “1. These Regulations determine the procedure for assessing…”

units.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 2. Assessment of a municipal servant (hereinafter, assessment) is conducted to determine their suitability for the municipal service position held. Assessment is intended to contribute to forming the municipal service workforce and improving municipal servants’ professional level.
units.label: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “2. Assessment of a municipal servant (hereinafter, assessment)…”
